note: Repixelizer now has one live reconstruction engine: phase-field in src/repixelizer/phase_field.py. The old tray-based optimizer is gone.
source_structure is tracked alongside source_fidelity because lattice-only scoring could rank visibly better outputs as worse.
The d9fa411 phase-field tuning pass was a real regression on the pinned badge case; reverting it restores the known-good badge result exactly.

Audit pass clarified note boundaries: the algorithm map remains the live control-flow truth, the implementation plan remains the forward hypothesis ledger, and hosted-auth-architecture is explicitly future design rather than landed auth machinery.

Hosted auth was split into a reusable GameCult hosted-access architecture plus a thin Repixelizer-specific access profile. Recommended extraction path is an embedded shared gamecult_access layer first, with dedicated service only after a second app proves the need.

Hosted convenience is the monetization path for Repixelizer; keep the code open, let self-hosting remain the escape hatch, and do not prioritize native desktop packaging unless it clearly beats hosted access on revenue, support burden, or strategy.

Added dense landscape fixture tests/fixtures/real/dense-landscape.png plus tracked fixed-512 output. Current automatic lattice inference on the 1254px source undershoots to 251x251, so README previews now include that case with the fixed 512x512 result beside Lanczos.

Dense landscape auto inference misses high because spacing stats split between false small-cell harmonics and mushier real-cell intervals. The spacing spectrum actually guides toward 415/418 and 251, but src/repixelizer/inference.py caps automatic major-axis candidates at 256, silently discarding the denser 415/418 branch; among the surviving sizes, reranking picks 251. Current phase/coherence scoring on the fixture is much stronger around 415-418 than at 251.

Relaxed automatic candidate search so high guided sizes from the spacing spectrum can survive above the old 256 cap. On tests/fixtures/real/dense-landscape.png, auto inference now lands at 418x418 instead of 251x251; still short of the fixed 512x512 target, but no longer throwing away most of the detail before scoring starts.

Tried a projected edge-energy spectral lattice prior and removed it before ship. On tests/fixtures/real/dense-landscape.png it floor-hugged to a 2px rhythm and widened the candidate family toward bogus 626-size aliases, so the searched path is back to change-interval evidence plus autocorrelation.

Removed pixel-walk / change-interval sizing from src/repixelizer/inference.py and switched searched lattice inference to autocorrelation-only priors and candidate hints. Badge auto inference no longer gets pruned into the old 115-family by spacing-spectrum guidance; it now searches inside the 120-126 neighborhood while dense landscape still lands at 418x418.

Autocorr inference now keeps a tiny near-best lag plateau and searches for cross-axis consensus before collapsing to one lattice size. On the real badge fixture this preserves x-axis support for 10px alongside 11px, raises the shared prior to the 125-family, and restores auto inference to 125 with top candidates 125/126/124/127/123 while dense landscape remains 418x418.

Hosted demo jobs now use direct autocorr lattice inference with one cheap phase probe, capped by the hosted output limit. The hosted path no longer silently pins unspecified jobs to max_output_dimension, and phase rerank is forced off there while the full local workflow keeps searched autocorr inference available.

Hosted mode now owns a distinct public front door in src/repixelizer/gui.py: / serves a landing page there, while local and self-host runs still redirect root straight to /app/. This keeps future auth and member-gating surgery in the hosted web layer instead of smearing it into the self-deploy path or the solver stack.

Repixelizer is now auth-ready at the hosted web boundary without landing real Heimdall auth. src/repixelizer/access.py owns the local access seam, src/repixelizer/gui.py binds request subjects and guards hosted routes, queued jobs now carry local owner metadata, and self-host remains permissive by default unless GC_ACCESS_* turns the seam on.

Repixelizer now consumes Heimdall entirely inside the hosted web layer. GC_ACCESS_MODE=heimdall creates local auth attempts, asks Heimdall to start provider OAuth, accepts the direct backend callback, verifies Heimdall Ed25519 access tokens locally, and adopts httpOnly cookie sessions without dragging provider tokens through browser URLs or solver code.
